# Player Pos Tier iGroups players within a position who are close enough in value that it shouldn't matter much which one you get, with a real gap before the next group -- computed from VOR gaps, not a fixed number of players per tier. Everyone below replacement level at a position shares one last, undifferentiated tier. Team Consensus Pts VOR iValue over replacement: how many more fantasy points this player is projected to score than a bench-level replacement at the same position, given this league's roster settings (8 teams, superflex). This is the sort order for this table. Proj Vol iHow much the 4 scraped sources (ESPN, FantasySharks, Walterfootball, FFToday) disagree on this player's projected fantasy points, as a share of their average. Higher = more disagreement between sources. Weekly Vol iHow volatile this player's own real week-to-week fantasy scoring was in past seasons, as a share of their average. Higher = more boom-or-bust; lower = more consistent. Boom% iShare of this player's past games where they scored 20+ fantasy points. Bust% iShare of this player's past games where they scored 5 or fewer fantasy points. Draft
